gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-miriam-li: Wire-thin and loud at once. And Miriam Libre, a modern sans-serif with an open-bend s and a lowercase of cast-iron stature, stands against Eight Bit Dragon's slightly pinched, widely spaced display letters with striking confidence.
